extra/threat_model_complete.txt.title: OWASP risk lookup
note: **Keeps only the OWASP risks whose `applies_to` list includes this component's type.**
- An `agent` inherits prompt injection, excessive agency, and more; a `datastore` only a couple

extra/threat_model_complete.txt.title: Likelihood × impact scoring
note: **Scores each risk: exposure weight (1–3) × impact, then bands the result.**
- Impact is 2, or 3 with PII; LLM02/LLM06 get +1, capped at 3
- Bands: HIGH ≥ 8, MEDIUM 5–7, LOW < 5

extra/rag_hardened_complete.txt.title: Trusted source allowlist
note: **Only chunks from these two vetted documents are ever used.**
- The poisoned doc isn't listed, so its chunks get dropped

extra/rag_hardened_complete.txt.title: Filter patterns and threshold
note: **Guard config: injection phrasing, bad-output strings, minimum similarity.**
- INJECTION_PATTERNS catch override wording hidden in retrieved chunks
- BAD_OUTPUT_PATTERNS name the phishing domains and PII asks
- RELEVANCE_MIN drops low-similarity chunks

extra/rag_hardened_complete.txt.title: Chunk filter (defense in depth)
note: **Every retrieved chunk must pass all three checks or it's logged and dropped.**
- Order: trusted source → injection scan → relevance threshold
- Watch for [BLOCKED] lines when you rerun

extra/rag_hardened_complete.txt.title: Output redaction
note: **Final check: scrub phishing domains and PII requests from the answer.**
- Matches become [REDACTED]; each hit is logged

extra/guardrails_complete.txt.title: Jailbreak patterns + topic allowlist
note: **Config for the input guards: known jailbreak phrasing and permitted topics.**
- Regex catches 'ignore instructions', persona swaps, prompt-reveal asks
- ALLOWED_TOPICS keeps the bot on support topics only

extra/guardrails_complete.txt.title: Jailbreak guard
note: **Fails any input matching a jailbreak regex.**
- Guards return (ok, reason, text); the pipeline stops on first failure

extra/guardrails_complete.txt.anchor: if any(t in text.lower() for t in ALLOWED_TOPICS):
extra/guardrails_complete.txt.title: Topic allowlist guard
note: **Input must mention at least one allowed topic — fails closed otherwise.**
- Allowlists beat blocklists: you can't enumerate every bad topic

extra/guardrails_complete.txt.title: Length guard
note: **Rejects oversized input — a cheap first defense against flooding and smuggling.**

extra/guardrails_complete.txt.endAnchor: BANNED_OUTPUT = [r"here is how to make", r"http://", r"\bpassword is\b"]
extra/guardrails_complete.txt.title: PII + banned-output patterns
note: **Config for the output guards: PII regexes and phrases never to emit.**
- SSN, card, email, phone formats; plus banned phrases like http:// links

extra/guardrails_complete.txt.title: PII redaction guard
note: **Redacts any PII found in the model's output before it ships.**
- Returns the redacted text so you can see what was caught

extra/guardrails_complete.txt.title: Banned-output guard
note: **Blocks output containing any banned phrase.**

extra/guardrails_complete.txt.title: Guard pipeline wiring
note: **Registers the guards main() runs, in order, on input then output.**
- Cheapest check (length) goes first
- Llama Guard adds a model-based layer after these (needs GROQ_API_KEY)

extra/secure_agent_complete.txt.title: Control 1: least privilege
note: **This task only ever gets these three tools — export/delete are never offered.**
- A hijacked plan that calls anything else is refused outright

extra/secure_agent_complete.txt.title: Control 2: human approval gate
note: **High-risk tools pause for an operator; low-risk tools run freely.**
- In this unattended demo the operator always denies

extra/secure_agent_complete.txt.title: Control 3: step budget
note: **Caps actions per run so a hijacked agent can't loop or escalate past the limit.**

extra/secure_server_complete.txt.title: Per-tool scope check
note: **403 unless the JWT's scopes include tools:<name>.**
- Runs in FastMCP middleware, so every tool is protected by default
- ToolError becomes a proper MCP error response

extra/observable_agent_complete.txt.title: Traced tool call + audit log
note: **Wraps each tool call in an OpenTelemetry span carrying security attributes.**
- Records user, tool, args, sensitive, status; denied calls get ERROR status
- The [AUDIT] line prints the trace/span ids you'll see in the output

extra/observable_agent_complete.txt.title: Anomaly detector
note: **Scans the collected spans for three signals worth a human's attention.**
- DENIED sensitive calls, BURST (≥3 of the same sensitive call), sensitive-tool users to REVIEW
- Powers the ANOMALY DETECTION block at the end of the run

extra/target_agent_complete.txt.title: Hijack + restricted-intent patterns
note: **Regex catalog of prompt-injection phrasing and intents HR must never act on.**
- Hijack: 'ignore instructions', persona swaps, prompt-reveal asks
- Restricted: SSN requests, exports, all-staff sends

extra/target_agent_complete.txt.title: Prompt screen
note: **Checks the prompt against both lists before it ever reaches the model.**
- Returns (True, reason) on first match — rerun the scorecard to see attacks BLOCKED

extra/policy_engine_complete.txt.title: Policy enforcement chain
note: **Applies policy in order: rate limit → tool deny/allow → query type → data scope.**
- Deny-list beats allow-list; unknown tools fail closed
- First failed check returns (False, reason) — that reason shows in the demo output

extra/security_gate_complete.txt.title: Secret signatures
note: **Regexes for leaked credentials: API keys, hardcoded passwords, AWS keys.**

extra/security_gate_complete.txt.title: Secret scanner
note: **Greps every .py file in the app for the secret patterns.**
- Any hit becomes a finding that fails the gate later

extra/security_gate_complete.txt.title: Dockerfile lint checks
note: **Two checks: base image must be pinned, container must not run as root.**
- :latest (or no tag) and a missing USER directive are findings

extra/security_gate_complete.txt.title: Dependency CVE scan
note: **Flags any pinned version older than the CVE database's fixed_in.**
- Simple version-tuple compare — older than the fix means vulnerable

extra/security_gate_complete.txt.title: Artifact hashing + signing
note: **SHA-256 over all app files, then an HMAC signature written to release_manifest.json.**
- Lets deployment verify the artifact wasn't tampered with
